title: The Evil Mermaid Queen
notes: Human Bowie (pages 6–7, 13–14) must stay on variant human-beach with pink outfit and sandals. Page 8 uses mermaid-transforming (merge of human-beach + mermaid-transformed). Full mermaid form is mermaid-transformed. Do not invent a second human wardrobe between pages.

variants.label: Human Bowie on the beach
variants.hair: blonde, shoulder-length, straight with soft waves

outfit.bottom: simple light shorts or skirt in a soft coordinating pink or white
outfit.shoes: simple pink or light sandals (not sneakers, not high-tops)
outfit.hairAccessory: pink hair tie or small pink bow

variants.label: Bowie mid-transformation into mermaid
variants.hair: blonde hair visibly shifting into big flowing magenta-and-blue mermaid hair (same girl, continuous identity)

outfit.onePiece: pink short-sleeve shirt and pink/white shorts or skirt partially dissolving into a sparkling green rainbow mermaid fin/tail; legs mid-change into fin; still recognizably the same Bowie
outfit.shoes: sandals gone or dissolving in shallow water — no sneakers
outfit.hairAccessory: pink hair tie/bow may be fading or falling away as mermaid hair takes over

forbidden: different face or age from human-beach Bowie
fully human with no mermaid cues
fully mermaid with no remaining human-beach cues

outfit.onePiece: mermaid top with a sparkling green fin/tail with rainbow sheen (no human legs)

variants.label: Evil Mermaid Queen powerful
variants.hair: long dramatic dark-purple jewel-toned mermaid hair

outfit.onePiece: regal black-and-purple mermaid queen attire with a tall crown and a large magic wand topped with a purple crystal (wand not trident)

variants.label: Queen mid-reform into nice young mermaid
variants.hair: dark-purple villain hair visibly softening into bright friendly purple hair on a younger small mermaid (same character continuous identity)
variants.eyes: mean eyes softening into kind eyes
variants.skin: cool undertone shifting to soft friendly mermaid skin

outfit.onePiece: regal black-and-purple queen attire dissolving into a simple friendly young-mermaid look (shell top OK) with a regular small mermaid tail; body clearly MUCH smaller than Mermaid Bowie
extras: tall villain crown falling off or already gone
black/dark oversized queen wand dropping from her hands (falling away, she can no longer hold it)

forbidden: still wearing tall menacing crown firmly
second separate nice mermaid besides the reforming queen

variants.label: Nice small mermaid
variants.hair: friendly young-mermaid purple hair (soft jewel-tone purple), not a tall menacing queen crown look

outfit.onePiece: simple friendly small/young mermaid (shell top or simple mermaid top OK) with a regular mermaid tail, no oversized queen wand, no tall villain crown

pages.sceneGoal: Book cover: Evil Mermaid Queen as the dramatic focus; title area kept clear.
Beach with an old wooden sign partly covered by vines; readable tease of the word Mermaids.
Visitors hurry into sparkling water past the vine-covered caution sign.
Underwater: Evil Mermaid Queen zaps swimmers into fish with her wand.
Only the Evil Mermaid Queen (no other mermaids). Fish and non-mermaid sea creatures bring her treasure.
Queen gloats over treasure and power — mwa ha ha energy, still kid-safe.
Bowie arrives at the beach and peels back vines to read the whole sign.
Bowie realizes the mermaids are bad — same human-beach look as page 6.
Bowie wades in with her wand mid-transformation: same girl as human-beach, pink outfit dissolving into green rainbow fin, hair shifting blonde to magenta-and-blue.
Mermaid Bowie swims toward the queen's lair with magenta-and-blue hair and green rainbow fin.

Queen sends fish at Mermaid Bowie; Bowie frees them into people swimming upward. Exactly two mermaids (Bowie + Queen). Show fish and/or newly restored humans with legs — never extra mermaids/merfolk children.
Magic duel between Mermaid Bowie and the Evil Mermaid Queen.
Mermaid Bowie zaps the queen; show queen mid-reform — shrinking into a purple-haired young nice mermaid while dropping her black/dark oversized wand. Exactly two mermaids.
Back on shore: human Bowie posts a Nice Mermaid sign; reformed mermaid nearby.
Sunset beach party; Nice Mermaid waves from the water.
